observed_evidence: All 45 products follow a common recorded cost schedule; supplier payments and terms are not present in the transactions.
evidence_required: Comparable invoices and contracts, freight, rebates, credit terms, minimum orders, service levels and usable yield at Garden purchase volumes.
conditional_action: If a comparable avoidable purchasing premium is confirmed, obtain equivalent offers and trial actual invoice-backed savings after implementation expenses.

observed_evidence: Matching product names and fixed recorded schedules do not establish equivalent ingredients, recipes, portions or quality.
evidence_required: Ingredient and recipe specifications, portion weights, usable yields, supplier specifications and quality checks for equivalent products.
conditional_action: Evaluate like-for-like offers and customer quality acceptance before reducing costs; retain a premium where verified value outweighs alternatives.

observed_evidence: A uniform recorded premium is compatible with allocation differences; underlying expense and allocation records are absent.
evidence_required: Allocation rules, general-ledger detail, cost-center mappings and reconciliation of branch charges to Stories total expenses.
conditional_action: Correct performance comparisons if allocations differ; count cash savings only where Stories underlying expenses actually fall.

observed_evidence: Transactions contain no measured waste; constant unit costs neither establish waste as the cause nor impose a savings ceiling.
evidence_required: Inventory movements, waste weights and reasons, recipe yields, spoilage records and any standard waste allowances included in unit costs.
conditional_action: Measure avoidable waste and test a targeted reduction while preserving quality; count its cost once and require observed financial benefit after expenses.

observed_evidence: Fixed schedules are compatible with a persistent mapping or entry error; schedule consistency alone cannot confirm or dismiss an error.
evidence_required: Product master records, system settings, import mappings, edit history and reconciliation of recorded costs to source invoices and accounting records.
conditional_action: Correct a verified recording error and restate comparisons; do not count an accounting correction as cash savings unless underlying expenses fall.

observed_evidence: Sales quantities are observed, but purchase quantities, negotiated tiers and volume rebates are absent.
evidence_required: Supplier tier schedules, actual order quantities, rebates, minimum commitments, delivery terms and inventory carrying or spoilage implications.
conditional_action: Compare attainable terms at actual purchase volumes; test pooling or tier changes only after all commitments and additional costs are included.
